flags.observation: Style A sets a female lead, but the speaker announces "I'm Uncle FrizzleBob"; voice and persona clash in variant A.
"My dating profile promised" lets a thing act like a person in the intro; mild object-acting.
"Hyena grabs a mask" is a scene cut with no therefore/but link to The Big Misunderstanding.
"Jokes out, corset on" repeats the opener family of "Mask off, club down" only seven lines later.
"corset" is not in the card art for The Historical Cage; invented image in the opener.
Card's risk caveat is cut; "legitimate if trauma is followed" now reads as plain endorsement of dark romance.
"their own wound, fear of commitment, or they are just a prop" parses as three alternatives; the requirement is lost.
The card's core claim about the character ceasing to perform is dropped; "the character simply is" lands cryptic.
"tools for emotional truth" has lost its subject from the card; the clause dangles and closes nothing.
"Equal? Smash a wall" reuses the one-word-question opener family two beats after "Hush? Feathers up".
Cheerful "Smash a wall" right before "a transgression of limits" in the erotica run sounds glib about crossing limits.
"Loss? Ink out" is the third same-family opener within four beats; the template becomes an audible tic.
Outro punch runs 123 characters in two clauses; strong satire on dating companies, but not one-breath quotable.
